mapper.update: UPDATE generation_task_step s JOIN generation_task t ON t.id=s.task_id SET s.status='FAILED',s.finished_at=#{now},s.message='服务重启，步骤被中断' WHERE s.status='RUNNING' AND t.status='FAILED' AND t.error_code='INTERRUPTED'
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM generation_task_step s JOIN generation_task t ON t.id=s.task_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} AND s.task_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.id
